about: Independent piano tuner and restorer working alone, with home clients, a music school and a few venues

messages.subject: Tuning before the holidays
messages.body: Hi Lucia, could you come and tune our piano sometime in the next couple of weeks? Mornings are best for us. Thanks, Clara

messages.subject: Re: Tuning before the holidays
messages.body:
Hi Clara, Tuesday the 6th at 9:30 works for me. See you then!

Lucia
Ferraro Pianos

messages.subject: November issue: humidity control and hammer voicing
messages.body: In this issue: room humidity control for older uprights, voicing tips for worn hammers, and a profile of a restoration shop. Read online. Unsubscribe.

messages.subject: Recital hall piano before Dec 12
messages.body:
Dear Lucia,

Our winter recital is on Saturday December 12. Could you tune and check the concert grand in the recital hall a day or two before? Last year's visit was excellent and the students noticed.

Best wishes,
Thomas Wright
Facilities Manager, Linden Conservatory

messages.subject: Re: Recital hall piano before Dec 12
messages.body:
Dear Thomas, happy to. I've put you down for Thursday December 10 at 9:00. I'll need about three hours in a quiet hall.

Lucia

messages.subject: Upright tuning
messages.body: Hello Lucia, a neighbor recommended you. Can you tune our upright next week? It's been two years, I'm a bit embarrassed to say. Greta Holm

messages.subject: Re: Upright tuning
messages.body:
Hi Greta, no need to be embarrassed, two years is very normal! Tuesday at 14:00? It may need a pitch raise first, which takes a little longer.

Lucia

messages.subject: Invoice: Ames job
messages.body:
Hi Lucia, attached is our invoice for the stair carry at Mr. Ames' place last week, your share as agreed is 180. Thanks for the smooth job.

Greta Novak
Novak Movers

messages.subject: Re: Invoice: Ames job
messages.body: Paid this morning. Thanks Greta, great crew as always.

messages.subject: Ihre Bestellung 30418
messages.body:
Sehr geehrte Frau Ferraro,

leider haben wir Ihnen bei der Bestellung 30418 die Saiten in Stärke 17 statt 16 geschickt. Das tut uns sehr leid. Bitte schicken Sie die falschen Saiten nicht zurück, wir senden die richtigen so schnell wie möglich.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Karl Bergmann

messages.subject: Re: Ihre Bestellung 30418
messages.body:
Sehr geehrter Herr Bergmann,

danke für die Nachricht. Bitte senden Sie die richtigen Saiten per Express, ich warte mit einer Restaurierung darauf.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Lucia Ferraro

messages.subject: Restauration de notre piano
messages.body:
Bonjour Lucia,

Où en est la restauration de notre piano ? Nous avons des invités pour les fêtes et ma femme aimerait beaucoup jouer pour eux. Est-ce que vous avez une date ?

Merci et bonne soirée,
Paul Dupont

messages.subject: Re: Restauration de notre piano
messages.body:
Bonjour Paul,

Le travail est presque fini, mais j'attends les bonnes cordes de mon fournisseur. Je vous donne une date dès que je les ai, normalement avant la mi-novembre.

Bonne journée,
Lucia

messages.subject: Re: Ihre Bestellung 30418
messages.body:
Sehr geehrte Frau Ferraro,

die richtigen Saiten sind heute per Express an Sie unterwegs. Die Lieferung ist für Sie kostenlos.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Karl Bergmann

messages.subject: Re: Restauration de notre piano
messages.body:
Bonjour Lucia,

Le piano est de retour et il est magnifique ! Ma femme joue tous les soirs. Merci pour tout, et la facture est payée.

Bien à vous,
Paul

messages.subject: Sticky key on our baby grand
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Ferraro,

Our baby grand at home has a sticky key (the D above middle C) and a faint buzz in the bass. Could you take a look sometime soon?

Harold Pike
Partner, Pike & Lowe

messages.subject: Piano at home
messages.body:
Hi Lucia, Harold again, this time from my home email so my wife sees it too. The sticky D and the bass buzz on our baby grand: could you come next week? Any evening is fine.

Harold Pike
(Pike & Lowe by day)

messages.subject: Re: Piano at home
messages.body:
Hi Harold, got both your emails. Thursday at 18:00 works; it sounds like a key bushing and a loose part in the bass, both quick fixes.

Lucia

messages.subject: Order shipped: hammer felt and center pins
messages.body: Hi Lucia, your order of hammer felt (2 sheets) and center pins (size 24) shipped today and should arrive Thursday. Thanks for your order! Dana at Larchmont Supply

messages.subject: Borrow a hammer?
messages.body: Hi Lucia, could I borrow your hammer and the long level this weekend? Putting up shelves for Jo finally. Ed next door

messages.subject: Re: Borrow a hammer?
messages.body: Sure, they're in the shed, it's open. Good luck with the shelves!

messages.subject: Re: Borrow a hammer?
messages.body: Returned, thanks! Shelves are up and level. Mostly.

messages.subject: Your quarterly tax estimate is ready
messages.body: Your quarterly tax estimate is ready. Log in to review it.

messages.subject: Spring tuning and a teacher?
messages.body: Hi Lucia, could you put us down for the spring tuning again? And a question: do you know a good piano teacher for an 8-year-old around here? Our son finally wants lessons. Joy

messages.subject: Re: Spring tuning and a teacher?
messages.body:
Hi Joy, spring tuning is booked for March 9. For a teacher, Linden Conservatory has a children's program on Saturdays; ask for the junior department.

Lucia

messages.subject: Piano teacher for Sofia
messages.body: Ciao cuz! Sofia wants to start piano lessons after New Year. You must know a teacher near Riverside? Someone patient, she's shy. Hugs, Marco

messages.subject: Re: Piano teacher for Sofia
messages.body: So exciting! Try Mrs. Halvorsen on Birch Street, she's wonderful with shy kids. Tell her I sent you.

messages.subject: Re: Recital hall piano before Dec 12
messages.body: Dear Lucia, confirming Thursday December 10 at 9:00. The hall will be unlocked and quiet until noon. Best, Thomas

messages.subject: Old upright piano
messages.body:
Hi Lucia,

Nadia gave me your address, hope that's okay. We're clearing out my late aunt's house and there's an old upright in the living room. Is it worth anything, or should we donate it? We need the house empty by mid-December.

Thanks,
Thomas Wright

messages.subject: Re: Old upright piano
messages.body: Hi Thomas, of course. Send me a photo of the inside of the lid and the serial number and I'll tell you honestly. Most old uprights are worth more to a school than on the market.

messages.subject: Webinar: pricing your restoration work
messages.body: Join our members' webinar on December 8 about pricing restoration work. Free for members. Register now.

messages.subject: Afinación antes de Navidad
messages.body:
Hola Lucia,

¿Puedes venir a afinar el piano antes de Navidad? Mi hija tiene un concierto en la escuela y quiere practicar con el piano bien afinado. Estamos en casa por las tardes.

Gracias y saludos,
Rafael Soto

messages.subject: Re: Afinación antes de Navidad
messages.body:
Hola Rafael,

Sí, claro. ¿Te va bien el jueves 17 de diciembre a las 16:00? Son unas dos horas.

Saludos,
Lucia

messages.subject: Re: Afinación antes de Navidad
messages.body:
Perfecto, el jueves a las 16:00. ¡Muchas gracias!

Rafael

messages.subject: Re: Upright tuning
messages.body: It sounds wonderful, thank you! I'll pay the invoice tonight.

messages.subject: Winter catalog: 15% off tools
messages.body: Our winter catalog is out. 15% off tuning hammers and mutes until December 15.

messages.subject: Van and tools policy renewal
messages.body: Dear Ms. Ferraro, your van and tools policy renews on January 1 at the same premium. No action is needed unless your tools are worth more than the 12,000 insured. Kestrel Mutual

messages.subject: Tuning schedule for 2027
messages.body:
Hi Lucia, we'd like to set up a regular tuning schedule for the two grands at Harbor Arts Center next year, about ten visits. Could you send a quote?

Nina Cole
Production Manager

messages.subject: Re: Tuning schedule for 2027
messages.body:
Hi Nina, thanks for thinking of me. Quote attached: ten visits for both grands, with concert touch-ups at a lower rate. Happy to adjust.

Lucia

messages.subject: Payment received
messages.body: You received a payment of 240.00 from P. Dupont.

messages.subject: Price for regulation?
messages.body: Hello, what would a full regulation cost for a 1960s upright? The action feels heavy and uneven. Thanks, Owen Lark

messages.subject: Bench
messages.body: Hi Lucia, silly question, do you sell adjustable piano benches? My daughter is too short for ours. Greta

messages.subject: Re: Bench
messages.body: Not a silly question! I don't sell them, but a footstool with a box works fine until she grows. Larchmont Supply has adjustable ones if you want to buy.

messages.subject: Thanksgiving at mine?
messages.body: Hey! Thanksgiving at mine this year? Mom's bringing the pie, can you do the green beans? B

messages.subject: Re: Thanksgiving at mine?
messages.body: Yes! Green beans it is. I'll come early to help.

messages.subject: New this week
messages.body: New this week on Streamly: three new series and a concert film. Watch now.

messages.subject: Dinner Friday?
messages.body: Dinner Friday at the Thai place? 19:30? Also I gave your email to a friend of a friend with an old piano, hope that's ok!

messages.subject: Re: Dinner Friday?
messages.body: Yes to both! See you Friday.

messages.subject: Holiday opening hours
messages.body: Our holiday opening hours are online. Stay strong this winter!

messages.subject: Bezoek in januari
messages.body:
Hoi Lucia,

Wij komen in januari een week naar jullie kant van de oceaan! Heb je zin om een dag samen iets te doen? Ik ben er van 8 tot 15 januari. Het zou zo leuk zijn om je weer te zien.

Liefs,
Femke

messages.subject: Re: Bezoek in januari
messages.body:
Hoi Femke,

Ja, wat leuk! Zaterdag 9 januari ben ik vrij. Wij kunnen naar de kust gaan als het weer goed is.

Liefs,
Lucia

messages.subject: Your November energy bill
messages.body: Your November bill of 71.20 will be collected on the 15th.

messages.subject: Re: Thanksgiving at mine?
messages.body: Thanks for yesterday, it was perfect. Photos attached, the one of mom with the pie is a keeper.

messages.subject: Cyber week fares
messages.body: Cyber week: fares from 59. Book by Monday.

messages.subject: A hold is ready for you
messages.body: Your hold is ready for pickup at the Main branch until December 4.

messages.subject: Appointment confirmation
messages.body: Hi Lucia, confirming your cleaning on Tuesday December 15 at 8:30. Reply if you need to change it. Ortiz Dental

messages.subject: Thank you
messages.body: Hi Lucia, just wanted to say the piano still sounds lovely. I've recommended you to two friends.

messages.body: Good news: invoice 2026-118 to Greta Holm was paid.

send the correct strings as soon as possible
give a date once the strings arrive
come Thursday at 18:00 to fix the key and the buzz

traps.what: Two different people named Thomas Wright: the conservatory facilities manager (work, recital grand) and a private person clearing an aunt's house (personal, old upright). Both are about a piano in mid-December, but they are unrelated.
Greta Holm, a tuning client, and Greta Novak at the movers only share a first name; the movers' invoice is for a different client.
Hammer felt from the supplier and a neighbor borrowing a hammer only share the word hammer.
A client and Lucia's cousin both want a piano teacher for a child, but one is work and one is personal; both were already answered on their own.
The wrong strings held up Paul's restoration, but the correct strings came and Paul has his piano back and paid.
Harold Pike wrote from his work and his home address about the same sticky key; it is one request, and Lucia already booked the visit.
